sources.snippet: Warfarin dose prediction — Phase 3 winner (AutoGluon extreme_quality, iwpc_6256) Trained on the iwpc_6256 IWPC cohort (combined clinical+genetic feature set) as part of the warfarin dose/INR systematic-review model-dev pipeline. Winner of Phase 3's nested clinical/genetic ablation comparator sweep (TRAINING_PLAN.md).

sources.title: HasanBGit/WarfaRisk: Official code for WarfaRisk - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains the official code, splits, and results for WarfaRisk, a nine-phase, fully reproducible machine learning pipeline for warfarin maintenance-dose prediction on the public IWPC pharmacogenomic cohorts. Our best model (AutoGluon extreme_quality, combined clinical+genetic features) reaches MAE 8.552 / R² 0.475 / PW20 0.466 on IWPC-6256 and MAE 7.959 / R² 0.480 / PW20 0.497 ...
